li.p: When the vehicle is turned to POWER ON or DRIVE READY, the air bag warning light should appear for approximately 3–6 seconds and go off.
The air bag warning light does not turn on briefly when the vehicle is turned to POWER ON or DRIVE READY.
The air bag warning light stays on after illuminating for approximately 3–6 seconds.
The air bag warning light comes on while the vehicle is moving.
